description: BURST SCOPE from EXPERIMENTS: how one frequency is used in time. Times every burst over the floor on any radio the board has (LR2021, RTL-SDR, HackRF): a live level trace against the threshold, a timeline of the last few periods, length and gap histograms, the rhythm in big figures with one period drawn to scale, and the newest bursts. Key fobs, tyre sensors and toll readers are presets. Energy and timing only.
